title: refactor(devtools): defer tabs
description:
Defer tab loading and rendering on app initialization.

## What is the current behavior?

All tabs are rendered on app load but they are visually hidden until they are opened.

## What is the new behavior?

The tabs are now deferred. After they are opened for the first time, they will be shown/hidden depending on the active tab state (i.e. similarly to what we have now).
